lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately four identifiable horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, with inter-centroid distances increasing along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle transverse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal spot rows, forming a grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature runs along the dorsal-lateral boundary, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the superior surface and lower intensity shadow on the inferior surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, localized area of high-luminance depigmentation with irregular margins is visible on the lower flank, posterior to the pectoral fin attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: A zone of high-density, small-diameter high-luminance pixels is located in the region immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, distinct from the larger blobs on the mid-flank.
